info.block.cyberfarm.hologram_table: Projects a 3D map of the land around it, 16, 24 or 32 blocks every way (right-click to zoom): the relief in its map colours, every Drone Dock as a pillar of light and every drone as a dot moving live with a trail, cyan while it works, amber on its way home; players as arrows and hostile mobs as red dots. It wakes when you walk up to it. Needs no power.
item.cyberfarm.mini_frame.desc: Takes only the Builder Module or the Bomb Module
item.cyberfarm.harvester_module.desc: Harvests mature crops, melons and pumpkins, then replants.
item.cyberfarm.quarry_module.desc: Digs the surveyed area layer by layer, down to bedrock.
item.cyberfarm.quarry_module.cost: Per block: 20 FE + 10 FE per point of hardness
item.cyberfarm.transport_module.desc: Carries items from one container to another along the dock's route.
item.cyberfarm.planter_module.desc: Plants seeds from the dock on empty farmland in the work area.
item.cyberfarm.logger_module.desc: Fells whole trees in the work area, leaves included, and replants a sapling.
item.cyberfarm.logger_module.cost: Per log: 20 FE, per leaf block: 5 FE
item.cyberfarm.taxi_module.desc: Carries you, hanging from a hook, to the dock's taxi destination.
item.cyberfarm.rancher_module.desc: Shears sheep and any shearable mob, and milks cows and goats with buckets from the dock.
item.cyberfarm.fertilizer_module.desc: Grows crops and saplings with any fertilizer from the dock, bone meal or modded.
item.cyberfarm.builder_module.desc: Builds the structure linked to the dock with the Multiblock Projector, with blocks from the dock. Mini Drone Frame only.
item.cyberfarm.fisher_module.desc: Fishes in the water of its work area and brings the catch to the dock.
item.cyberfarm.breeder_module.desc: Feeds the animals of its work area two of a kind, with their food from the dock, so they breed. Stops at 16 of a kind.
item.cyberfarm.guard_module.desc: Hunts the hostile mobs of its work area and shoots them with a laser from above. Leaves named mobs, animals and villagers alone.
item.cyberfarm.guard_module.cost: Per shot: 50 FE (6 damage, one a second)
item.cyberfarm.bomb_module.cost: Per attack: the whole Mini Drone
item.cyberfarm.stack_addon.desc: +1 stack (64 items) carried per Transport trip.
item.cyberfarm.fortune_addon.desc: Fortune for Quarry and Harvester drops, one level each.
item.cyberfarm.silk_touch_addon.desc: Silk Touch for Quarry and Harvester drops. Cannot be combined with Fortune.
tooltip.cyberfarm.drone.empty: Build it in a Drone Assembler
tooltip.cyberfarm.drone.deploy_hint: Right-click a Drone Dock to deploy
tooltip.cyberfarm.survey.hint_dock: Click the Drone Dock to set up, sneak + click to reset it
tooltip.cyberfarm.survey.hint_area: Click two opposite corners to set the work area
tooltip.cyberfarm.survey.hint_route: Click the source container, then the destination (other drones' docks too)
tooltip.cyberfarm.survey.hint_taxi: Click the block where passengers land
tooltip.cyberfarm.survey.hint_mode: Sneak + mouse wheel, or right-click the air, to change mode
message.cyberfarm.drone.needs_dock: Right-click a Drone Dock to deploy the drone
message.cyberfarm.drone.dock_occupied: This dock already has a drone
message.cyberfarm.drone.swarm_only_mini: Only Mini Drones (built on a Mini Drone Frame) fit the Builder Swarm Dock
message.cyberfarm.drone.mini_needs_swarm: Mini Drones live on a Builder Swarm Dock
info.block.cyberfarm.swarm_dock: A Drone Dock for up to four Mini Drones (built on a Mini Drone Frame). They share its work area, route, build and stock, so four Builder Mini Drones raise one structure together. Right-click it with Mini Drones to deploy them.
info.item.cyberfarm.mini_frame: A small, cheap frame: half-size drones with a small battery that take only the Builder Module or the Bomb Module. Up to four of them share a Builder Swarm Dock.
message.cyberfarm.survey.linked: Linked to the Drone Dock at %s. %s
message.cyberfarm.survey.step.dock: Click the Drone Dock to set up
message.cyberfarm.survey.step.pick_mode: Sneak + scroll or right-click the air to pick Area, Route or Taxi
message.cyberfarm.survey.step.area_first: Click the first corner of the work area
message.cyberfarm.survey.step.taxi: Click the block where passengers land
message.cyberfarm.survey.wrong_mode: Dock mode only picks the dock: sneak + mouse wheel or right-click the air for Area, Route or Taxi
message.cyberfarm.survey.corner: First corner set at %s, now click the opposite corner
message.cyberfarm.survey.dock_missing: The linked Drone Dock is gone
message.cyberfarm.survey.too_big: Area too big: max %s x %s blocks, corners at most %s blocks apart in height
message.cyberfarm.survey.too_far: Too far from the dock (max %s blocks)
message.cyberfarm.survey.reset: Dock reset: default area, no transport route, no taxi destination
message.cyberfarm.survey.source: Route source set at %s, now click the destination container
message.cyberfarm.survey.same_container: Source and destination must be different containers
message.cyberfarm.survey.taxi_blocked: The taxi destination needs two blocks of air above it
gui.cyberfarm.assembler.slot.output: Finished drone (put one back here to disassemble it)
gui.cyberfarm.dock.return.hint: Call the drone home and keep it there
gui.cyberfarm.dock.resume.hint: Let the drone take jobs again
gui.cyberfarm.dock.build_obstacles: %s blocks in the way the drones cannot clear
gui.cyberfarm.dock.filter.hint: What the Quarry keeps (the rest is thrown away), what the Transport carries and how much of it
cyberfarm.configuration.title: CyberFarm Configs
category.cyberfarm.drone_assembly.tier: Tier %s: %s module slots, up to %s addons
category.cyberfarm.note.per_item: %s s per item, no power needed
category.cyberfarm.note.capsule: Bring mobs in with a Mob Capsule
category.cyberfarm.note.heat: Up to %s mB/t of water to steam
info.block.cyberfarm.combustion_generato: Burns any furnace fuel into FE (40 FE/t) and pushes it into every adjacent machine or Energy Conduit.
info.block.cyberfarm.drone_assembler: Builds drones: put a frame, one to three function modules and optional addons, then press Assemble (2,000 FE). Put a finished drone back in the output slot to disassemble it.
info.block.cyberfarm.drone_dock: Home of one drone: charges it, stores its cargo and keeps its work area, transport route and item filter (Filter button in its GUI). Right-click it with a drone to deploy it.
info.block.cyberfarm.energy_conduit: Carries FE between generators and machines of any mod. Conduits connect by themselves and share power between all the machines they touch, up to 2,000 FE/t per source. Advanced: 16,000. Elite: 128,000. Right-click an arm touching a block to pull out of it (batteries, tanks, machines).
info.item.cyberfarm.drone: Right-click a Drone Dock to deploy it. Sneak + right-click the flying drone with an empty hand to pick it up again.
info.item.cyberfarm.survey_tool: Has four modes, switched with sneak + mouse wheel or a right-click in the air. Dock: right-click a Drone Dock to link it (sneak to reset it). Area: two opposite corners set the work area. Route: two containers set a transport route, another drone's dock too. Taxi: the block passengers land on. It never opens the blocks it clicks.
info.item.cyberfarm.harvester_module: The drone harvests mature crops, melons and pumpkins in its work area and replants them.
info.item.cyberfarm.quarry_module: The drone digs its surveyed area layer by layer down to bedrock, in order, and unloads every 192 items. Only keeps the drops the dock filter lets through. Never digs the default area around the dock.
info.item.cyberfarm.transport_module: The drone carries items from the source container to the destination container of its dock's route: 16 items per trip, plus one stack per Stack Addon. Only items the dock filter lets through are moved.
info.item.cyberfarm.planter_module: The drone loads seeds from its dock (wheat seeds, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, melon and pumpkin seeds, modded crops) and plants them on empty farmland in the work area. It never tills soil by itself.
info.item.cyberfarm.logger_module: The drone fells every tree in its work area from the top down, collecting logs, saplings and apples, then replants a sapling where the trunk stood. Player-placed leaves are left alone.
message.cyberfarm.taxi.no_destination: No destination: sneak + right-click a block with the Survey Tool
message.cyberfarm.taxi.low_energy: Not enough charge for the trip: needs %s FE
info.item.cyberfarm.taxi_module: The drone waits above its dock with a hook. Right-click it to grab the hook: it climbs above the terrain, flies to the dock's taxi destination and drops you off, then flies home. Set the destination by sneak + right-clicking a block with the Survey Tool. Sneak to let go: you get Slow Falling.
info.item.cyberfarm.rancher_module: The drone shears every shearable mob in its work area (sheep, mooshrooms, modded ones) and milks cows and goats with empty buckets it takes from the dock. Wool, milk buckets and the rest go back to the dock.
info.item.cyberfarm.fertilizer_module: The drone grows the crops, stems and saplings of its work area with fertilizer from the dock: bone meal or any fertilizer from other mods (tag c:fertilizers). Grass and moss are left alone.
info.item.cyberfarm.fisher_module: The drone hovers over open water in its work area (a water source with air above it) and fishes like a fishing rod, with the vanilla fishing loot and odds: mostly fish, some junk and now and then treasure. The catch goes to the dock.
info.item.cyberfarm.breeder_module: The drone feeds the adult animals of its work area with their breeding food from the dock (wheat for cows, seeds for chickens, any food a modded animal eats), only when two of a kind are ready, so they breed. It stops once there are 16 of a kind in the area.
info.item.cyberfarm.guard_module: The drone patrols its work area (and 8 blocks above and below it) and shoots every hostile mob it finds with its laser: 6 damage a second, 50 FE a shot, from 3 blocks over the mob's head. It ignores players, animals, villagers, golems, named mobs, mobs riding something and neutral mobs that are not angry. Nothing can hurt the drone.
info.item.cyberfarm.bomb_module: Fits only the Mini Drone Frame. The Mini Drone waits on its Builder Swarm Dock until a hostile mob comes into its work area (or 8 blocks above or below it), then dives at it and explodes: a blast about a third of TNT's, which breaks a few blocks and hurts anything near, players included. The drone is used up. Each drone of the swarm goes for a different mob.
info.item.cyberfarm.builder_module: Fits only a Mini Drone Frame: building is work for a swarm of Mini Drones on a Builder Swarm Dock. The drone builds the structure linked to its dock: lock a projection with the Multiblock Projector, then right-click the dock with it. It places the missing blocks with blocks from the dock, lowest layer first, and never breaks anything in the way. The dock takes in only the blocks the build still needs, so a Transport drone can bring them from any storage.
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.machines.hint: CyberFarm machines: generators, the Drone Assembler, the Methane Extractor
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.drones.hint: Rotor hum, takeoff and landing of drones
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.animals.hint: Passive and neutral mobs: cows, chickens, villagers...
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.other_machines.hin: Sounds listed in the CyberFarm client config: by default furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers; add other mods' machines there
tooltip.cyberfarm.capsule.empty: Right-click a mob to capture it
tooltip.cyberfarm.capsule.release: Right-click a block to release, or a Methane Extractor to load its chamber
message.cyberfarm.extractor.incomplete: The extraction chamber is not complete
message.cyberfarm.extractor.occupied: There is already a mob in the chamber
message.cyberfarm.extractor.loaded: Mob placed in the extraction chamber
info.block.cyberfarm.gas_pipe: Carries gases (biogas, methane, Steam, any mod's gas) between tanks and machines of any mod; liquids need a Liquid Pipe. Pipes connect by themselves and share what enters between every block they touch, up to 1,000 mB/t per source. Advanced: 4,000. Elite: 16,000. Right-click an arm touching a block to pull out of it (batteries, tanks, machines).
info.block.cyberfarm.bio_digester: Turns organic waste (anything a composter takes, plus rotten flesh) into Biogas and pushes it into adjacent pipes and tanks. Needs no power.
info.block.cyberfarm.gas_turbine: Burns Biogas (3 FE/mB) or Methane (8 FE/mB) into FE, 20 mB per tick, and pushes the power into adjacent machines and conduits.
info.block.cyberfarm.methane_extractor: The top of a 3x3x4 chamber of Cyber Frame Blocks and Containment Glass; once complete it turns into one smooth tank. A mob inside is dissolved by Acid into Methane (zombies 25 mB/t, other monsters 12, animals 4), using 1 mB of acid per tick, and slowly consumed. Acid goes in through an Acid Inlet, methane comes out of a Methane Outlet; monsters walk in through an Intake Gate.
info.block.cyberfarm.cyber_frame: Sci-fi structural block used to build multiblocks, like the Methane Extractor chamber.
info.item.cyberfarm.mob_capsule: Right-click a mob to store it, then right-click a block to let it out, or a Methane Extractor to put it straight into its chamber. Released mobs never despawn. Bosses cannot be captured.
info.block.cyberfarm.muffler: Silences sounds within 10 blocks. Right-click it to choose what: CyberFarm machines, drones, monsters, animals and other sounds listed in the client config. Your own footsteps, doors and tools still make noise.
gui.cyberfarm.core.pylons.hint: This tier needs %s pylon columns, %s blocks tall, %s to %s blocks from the core, lined up on its sides with nothing between them and the crystal
gui.cyberfarm.core.pylon.details: Column %s blocks tall (needs %s), %s blocks away (%s to %s)
message.cyberfarm.pipe.normal: No longer pulling from this block
info.block.cyberfarm.liquid_tank: Stores 32 buckets of one liquid (water, lava, coolants, any mod's liquid). Fill it with Liquid Pipes or buckets; empty it with a bucket or a Liquid Pipe set to pull (right-click the pipe's arm). Right-click it to see what is inside.
info.block.cyberfarm.gas_tank: Stores 32,000 mB of one gas (biogas, methane, Steam, any mod's gas). Fill it with Gas Pipes; empty it with a Gas Pipe set to pull (right-click the pipe's arm). Right-click it to see what is inside.
message.cyberfarm.pump.no_water: Needs at least 2 water source blocks next to it
message.cyberfarm.turret.no_power: No power: a shot takes %s FE
message.cyberfarm.turret.watching: Watching for hostile mobs within %s blocks
info.block.cyberfarm.reactor_controller: Heart of the Fission Reactor: a cooling tower of Reactor Casings and Ports in three sizes (Small 5x5x7, Medium 7x7x11, Large 9x9x15), with the controller in the middle of a side of the second layer. Bigger towers burn more rods (2, 4 or 8), reach more power and move more heat. Fuel Rods heat the core; water turns into Steam for Steam Turbines. Raise the power for more steam, but keep it cooled: Coolant and Cryo Coolant carry more heat. At 100% temperature it melts down. Right-click any block of the formed tower to open it.
info.block.cyberfarm.reactor_casing: Shell of the Fission Reactor tower. Lights up when the tower is complete.
info.block.cyberfarm.reactor_port: Part of the reactor shell that pipes and hoppers connect to: Fuel Rods and water go in, Depleted Fuel Rods and steam come out.
info.block.cyberfarm.resonance_core: Buildable FE storage. Alone it holds 1,000,000 FE; a complete shell of Resonance Cells around its crystal (3x3x3, 5x5x5, 7x7x7) raises it to tier 2, 3 and 4, up to 2,000,000,000 FE. Power goes in and out only through its Stabilizer Pylons.
info.block.cyberfarm.stabilizer_pylon: Stack them into columns in line with a Resonance Core on its sides: each tier needs more columns, taller and farther away. A linked column fires its beam at the crystal and is the core's way in and out: connect cables to any of its blocks.
info.block.cyberfarm.resonance_cell: Shell piece of a Resonance Core: build a complete cube of them around the crystal, empty inside, to raise the core by a tier. Once complete they vanish inside the bigger crystal.
info.block.cyberfarm.water_pump: Next to 2 or more water source blocks it pumps 500 mB/t of water with 40 FE/t and pushes it into adjacent pipes and machines.
info.block.cyberfarm.laser_turret: Shoots the hostile mobs it can see within 16 blocks: 8 damage a second, 200 FE a shot from its 20,000 FE buffer. It ignores players, animals, villagers, golems, named mobs, mobs riding something and neutral mobs that are not angry. Right-click to see what it is doing.
info.item.cyberfarm.fuel_rod: Burns for 40 minutes in a Fission Reactor, then becomes a Depleted Fuel Rod.
gui.cyberfarm.reactor.temperature: Core %s °C — making %s heat/t, cooling up to %s/t, steam %s mB/t
info.block.cyberfarm.coolant_mixer: Makes reactor coolants with 20 FE/t: water + Lapis Lazuli → Coolant, Coolant + Blue Ice → Cryo Coolant, 500 mB per batch.
info.item.cyberfarm.biogas_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Biogas (e.g. a Bio-Digester or Gas Turbine). Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it back in. Gases are held upside down and cannot be poured into the world.
info.item.cyberfarm.methane_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Methane (e.g. a Methane Extractor or Gas Turbine). Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it back in. Gases are held upside down and cannot be poured into the world.
info.item.cyberfarm.steam_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Steam (e.g. a Fission Reactor port or Steam Turbine). Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it back in. Gases are held upside down and cannot be poured into the world.
info.item.cyberfarm.coolant_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a Coolant Mixer or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Coolant, or scoop it from a pool. Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it in, or anywhere else to pour it into the world: whoever wades through it freezes, slowly.
info.item.cyberfarm.cryo_coolant_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a Coolant Mixer or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Cryo Coolant, or scoop it from a pool. Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it in, or anywhere else to pour it into the world: whoever wades through it freezes much faster than in Coolant.
death.attack.cyberfarm.radiation.player: %1$s died of radiation sickness while fighting %2$s
death.attack.cyberfarm.laser: %1$s was burned down by a laser
tooltip.cyberfarm.depleted_fuel_rod: Radioactive! Contaminates the area around it
tooltip.cyberfarm.depleted_fuel_rod.hint: Treat it in a Waste Reprocessor
tooltip.cyberfarm.hazmat: Each piece keeps out 25% of radiation; the full suit, all of it
info.item.cyberfarm.depleted_fuel_rod: Nuclear waste. Carried, stored in a chest or any other mod's storage, or left on the ground it contaminates the chunk; enough contamination makes everything nearby sick and the land wither. Treat it in a Waste Reprocessor. A reactor with full waste slots leaks radiation.
info.block.cyberfarm.waste_reprocessor: Treats a Depleted Fuel Rod with 40 FE/t in 10 seconds: a harmless block of Vitrified Waste, an Uranium Ingot one time in three and an Isotope Shard one time in four. Waste inside it is shielded.
info.block.cyberfarm.vitrified_waste: Treated nuclear waste: inert glass, safe to store or to build with.
info.item.cyberfarm.hazmat_suit: Hazmat Suit: helmet, suit, pants and boots. Each piece keeps out a quarter of the radiation, the full suit all of it. It also keeps the cold of coolant pools out.
info.item.cyberfarm.geiger_counter: Hold it in either hand: it clicks faster where radiation is higher and shows the level in Rad above the hotbar. Sickness starts at 20 Rad, it gets serious at 100.
gui.cyberfarm.reactor.slot.unused: Not used by this tower size: build a bigger one
info.block.cyberfarm.turbine_controller: Heart of the Steam Turbine: a hall of Turbine Casings and Ports in three sizes (Small 3x3x4, Medium 5x5x6, Large 7x7x8), the controller in the middle of the front, the inside left empty for the rotor. Steam spins the rotor up; at full speed it uses 200, 600 or 1600 mB/t at 4, 5 or 6 FE per mB. Right-click any block of the formed turbine to open it.
info.block.cyberfarm.turbine_casing: Shell of the Steam Turbine hall. Lights up when the turbine is complete.
info.block.cyberfarm.turbine_port: Part of the turbine shell that pipes and cables connect to: steam goes in, FE comes out.
info.item.cyberfarm.multiblock_projector: Projects a multiblock as ghost blocks: what to place and where; wrong blocks show red. The structure stands on the block you aim at. Right-click to pick the structure from a list, sneak + right-click a block to lock the projection (on a controller it lines up with it), sneak + right-click the air to unlock. Right-click a Drone Dock with a locked projection: its Builder drones build it. In creative, right-clicking a block builds the structure instantly.
tooltip.cyberfarm.projector: Right-click: pick a structure. Sneak + right-click a block: lock. Right-click a Drone Dock: build it with drones.
projector.cyberfarm.reactor.desc: A cooling tower: fuel rods heat its core and water leaves as steam.
projector.cyberfarm.turbine.desc: Turns steam into power. Bigger turbines take more steam.
projector.cyberfarm.methane_chamber.desc: The acid chamber under a Methane Extractor: it dissolves mobs into methane.
projector.cyberfarm.resonance_core.desc: Stores energy in a shell of Resonance Cells, held by Stabilizer Pylons.
projector.cyberfarm.mech_hangar.desc: The rack a mech parks in: it charges, repairs and fits its modules.
projector.cyberfarm.crystallizer.desc: Grows a Fusion Crystal out of an Isotope Shard, for the Mech Core.
gui.cyberfarm.projector.hint: Sneak + right-click a block to lock the projection there, then right-click a Drone Dock with a Builder drone to have it built.
message.cyberfarm.projector.linked: %s linked: %s blocks to place, %s in the way that the drones cannot clear
message.cyberfarm.projector.lock_first: Lock a projection first (sneak + right-click a block)
info.block.cyberfarm.liquid_pipe: Carries liquids (water, lava, Coolant, Cryo Coolant, any mod's liquid) between tanks and machines of any mod; gases need a Gas Pipe. Never joins a Gas Pipe line, so both can run side by side. Up to 1,000 mB/t per source. Advanced: 4,000. Elite: 16,000. Right-click an arm touching a block to pull out of it (batteries, tanks, machines).
info.block.cyberfarm.advanced_liquid_pip: Liquid Pipe for big flows: up to 4,000 mB/t per source. Joins the network of any Liquid Pipe tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.elite_liquid_pipe: Liquid Pipe for whole power plants: up to 16,000 mB/t per source. Joins the network of any Liquid Pipe tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.advanced_energy_con: Energy Conduit for big generators: up to 16,000 FE/t per source, enough for a Large Steam Turbine. Joins the network of any conduit tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.elite_energy_condui: Energy Conduit for power plants: up to 128,000 FE/t per source. Joins the network of any conduit tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.advanced_gas_pipe: Gas Pipe for big flows: up to 4,000 mB/t per source, enough for the steam of a Large reactor. Joins the network of any pipe tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.elite_gas_pipe: Gas Pipe for whole power plants: up to 16,000 mB/t per source. Joins the network of any pipe tier.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.whitelist.hint: Whitelist: only matching items pass. Blacklist: everything but matching items passes.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.components.hint: Exact: the item must also match enchantments, damage, names and other data. Any: only the item counts.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.mod.hint: By mod: any item from the same mod as a sample matches.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.tag.hint: Pick one of the tags of the first sample (e.g. #c:ingots): every item with that tag matches.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.slots.hint: Click with an item to add it as a sample (nothing is used up); click empty-handed to clear.
info.block.cyberfarm.containment_glass: Framed, see-through walls for the Methane Extractor's chamber.
info.block.cyberfarm.nether_sulfur_ore: Found in netherrack all over the Nether. Drops 2-4 Sulfur (more with Fortune). Tagged c:ores/sulfur, so other mods' processing works on it.
info.item.cyberfarm.sulfur: Tagged c:dusts/sulfur: sulfur from other mods works too. The Acid Synthesizer turns it into Acid.
info.block.cyberfarm.acid_synthesizer: Makes Acid with 20 FE/t: 1 Sulfur + 500 mB Water → 500 mB Acid, in 2 seconds.
info.item.cyberfarm.acid_bucket: Acid for the Methane Extractor. Pour it into the extractor or a tank.
info.block.cyberfarm.steam_engine: The boiler of a Steam Engine. Put 1-4 Steam Engine Cylinders in a row behind it and a Dynamo at the end. Each cylinder burns 15 mB/t of Biogas (6 FE/mB) or Methane (10 FE/mB): up to 600 FE/t. It takes about 5 seconds to reach full speed.
info.block.cyberfarm.steam_engine_cylind: Part of a Steam Engine: 1-4 in a row behind the boiler. Each adds power and fuel use.
info.block.cyberfarm.steam_engine_dynamo: Closes a Steam Engine's row. The engine's power comes out here: connect Energy Conduits to it.
gui.cyberfarm.extractor.lure: Lure a monster to an Intake Gate
info.block.cyberfarm.acid_inlet: Takes the place of any Cyber Frame of a Methane Extractor chamber. Pipe Acid (or pour an Acid Bucket) into it to fill the chamber.
info.block.cyberfarm.methane_outlet: Takes the place of any Cyber Frame of a Methane Extractor chamber. The methane made inside is pushed out of it into adjacent Gas Pipes and tanks.
info.block.cyberfarm.intake_gate: Takes the place of a glass block in the lower wall of a Methane Extractor chamber. While the chamber is empty, the first monster that comes up to it is pulled inside (no bosses).
gui.cyberfarm.extractor.acid_hint: Pipe Acid into an Acid Inlet
tooltip.cyberfarm.mech_frame.hint: Right-click a Mech Hangar's pad to unfold it
info.item.cyberfarm.mech_frame: A folded pilotable mech. It only unfolds on the pad of a complete Mech Hangar: right-click the pad. Right-click the mech to climb in; the exit key (V) lets you out. The hangar's Fold button packs it back into its frame, keeping its battery charge and modules.
message.cyberfarm.mech.disabled: The mech is shut down: it needs repairs
tooltip.cyberfarm.mech_module.jet: Back mount: wings unfold; hold jump in the air to fly
tooltip.cyberfarm.mech_module.drill: Right arm: a drill (key R) that digs 3x3, any tier
tooltip.cyberfarm.mech_module.blade: Left arm: an energy blade (key G) that cuts and sweeps
tooltip.cyberfarm.mech_module.install: Fit it in a Mech Hangar's console
info.block.cyberfarm.mech_hangar: The console of a Mech Hangar, at the front-left corner of the 5x5 hangar: Hangar Frame pillars on the corners up to a ring of frames 5 blocks up, a 3x3 Hangar Pad in the middle. Once complete, right-click the console, any frame or the pad for its screen. A mech left empty on the pad is charged (2,000 FE/t from the console's battery), repaired and can have its modules fitted. A gantry arm on the rack carries each module to its mount, or takes it off.
info.block.cyberfarm.hangar_frame: The pillars and the top frame of a Mech Hangar.
info.block.cyberfarm.hangar_pad: The 3x3 charging pad in the middle of a Mech Hangar: park the mech on it.
info.item.cyberfarm.mech_jet_module: Goes on the mech's back, in a Mech Hangar. With the pilot inside, wings unfold from the back: hold jump in the air to climb, sneak to dive, neither to glide. Uses 60 FE/t in the air.
info.item.cyberfarm.mech_drill_module: Goes on the mech's right arm, in a Mech Hangar. The drill key (R) slides it out: it digs twice as fast, breaks 3x3 and gets the drops of any tier, 20 FE per extra block.
info.item.cyberfarm.mech_blade_module: Goes on the mech's left arm, in a Mech Hangar. The blade key (G) slides it out: 18 extra damage a blow and 8 to everything near the target, 80 FE a blow.
info.item.cyberfarm.mech_armor_module: Goes on the mech's trunk, in a Mech Hangar. With the pilot inside, plates close onto the shoulders, chest and thighs: the mech takes 40% less damage.
message.cyberfarm.mech.hangar_only: A mech only unfolds on the pad of a complete Mech Hangar
gui.cyberfarm.hangar.fold.tooltip: Fold the mech up: it drops on the pad as its frame, charge and modules kept
message.cyberfarm.mech.no_room: Something is in the way: the space over the pad must be clear
info.item.cyberfarm.isotope_shard: A rare sliver of isotope the Waste Reprocessor recovers from spent fuel, one rod in four. The Crystallizer grows it into a Fusion Crystal.
info.block.cyberfarm.crystallizer: The controller of a 3x3x4 chamber: Cyber Frames for the floor, the roof and the corners, Containment Glass walls, the two blocks in the middle empty, the Crystallizer in the middle of the floor's front. Complete, it becomes one faceted machine where a Fusion Crystal grows in an energy field from 1 Isotope Shard, 4 Amethyst Shards and 2,000 mB of Acid, with 1,000 FE/t for 30 seconds (600,000 FE). Acid, power and items go in through the Crystallizer or a Crystallizer Port; automation can only take the crystal out.
info.item.cyberfarm.fusion_crystal: Grown in the Crystallizer. The heart of a Mech Core.
info.item.cyberfarm.mech_core: A Fusion Crystal set in two elite frames: the power core every Mech Frame is built around.
tooltip.cyberfarm.crystallizer_port: Replaces a Cyber Frame of a Crystallizer chamber
info.block.cyberfarm.crystallizer_port: Takes the place of any Cyber Frame of a Crystallizer's chamber: floor, corners or roof. Once the chamber is complete, pipes, conduits, hoppers and item pipes connect to it as to the Crystallizer: Acid, power, Isotope Shards and Amethyst Shards go in, the Fusion Crystal comes out. Build as many as you like.

item.cyberfarm.anchor_addon.desc: Its dock keeps loaded the chunks the drone works in, so it goes on working when you are far away. The dock pays 4 FE/t per chunk.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.limit.hint: Transport Module: stop bringing an item once the destination holds this many of it. The arrows step through round numbers; hold Shift to step by one.
info.block.cyberfarm.bauxite_ore: The ore of aluminum, in stone and deepslate across the Overworld, mostly above y 48. Drops Raw Bauxite; tagged c:ores/bauxite.
info.item.cyberfarm.raw_bauxite: Smelt or blast it into Alumina.
info.item.cyberfarm.alumina: Aluminum oxide, smelted from bauxite. The Electrolyzer turns it into Aluminum Ingots. Tagged c:dusts/alumina.
info.item.cyberfarm.aluminum_ingot: Made by the Electrolyzer from Alumina. The light metal of the Basic and Mini Drone Frames. Tagged c:ingots/aluminum: other mods' aluminum works too.
info.block.cyberfarm.electrolyzer: Turns 1 Alumina into 1 Aluminum Ingot in 5 seconds with 40 FE/t: a Combustion Generator runs it.
info.item.cyberfarm.carbon_fiber: Made in the Pyrolysis Oven from Methane and String. The material of the Advanced and Elite Drone Frames.
info.block.cyberfarm.pyrolysis_oven: Splits Methane into carbon and hydrogen and draws the carbon onto String: 250 mB of Methane + 1 String -> 1 Carbon Fiber, in 4 seconds at 60 FE/t. Methane goes in through pipes.
info.item.cyberfarm.basic_circuit: The circuit of tier 1: drone modules, addons, docks, the Assembler and the first machines. Craft one by hand, or two at a time in the Fabricator.
info.item.cyberfarm.advanced_circuit: The circuit of tier 2, etched with Acid in the Fabricator: 2 Basic Circuits + 1 Gold Ingot + 250 mB of Acid.
info.item.cyberfarm.elite_circuit: The circuit of tier 3, etched with Acid in the Fabricator: 1 Advanced Circuit + 1 Diamond + 1 Uranium Ingot + 500 mB of Acid.
info.block.cyberfarm.fabricator: Makes circuits from the ingredients in its three slots, 40 FE/t: 2 Basic Circuits from copper, redstone and a gold nugget; Advanced and Elite Circuits etched with Acid, which goes in through pipes.

info.block.cyberfarm.supply_terminal: Place it in a village, or find one in a Drone Mechanist's Outpost: an unemployed villager takes it as his job site and becomes a Drone Mechanist. He posts three supply contracts on it, plus a Market Day each morning and a call to arms during raids. Deliver into its left slot by hand, hopper or Transport drone. Filled contracts pay emeralds and sometimes a bonus item, level the mechanist up, give you better prices and add to the village's prosperity. Right-click the Mechanist to talk: he offers to build a tech village with you, and raises its level once it is prosperous enough.
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.deliver: Deliver: what a contract wants (by hand, hopper or Transport drone)
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.payout: Pay: the emeralds of filled contracts
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.contract: The village wants %s %s and pays %s emeralds
Place a Supply Terminal for a Drone Mechanist
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.mechanist.hint: Drone Mechanist: %s. The free places on the board get new contracts when the timer runs out
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.no_mechanist.hint: An unemployed villager nearby must take this terminal as his job site
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.kind.market: Market Day: three times the size and the pay, until dusk
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.kind.defense: Call to arms: a raid is on!
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.prosperity.hint: %s / %s prosperity points for the next village level. Filled contracts add their emeralds; then talk to the Mechanist
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.prosperity.max: The village is at its top level (%s points): contracts pay half again
message.cyberfarm.terminal.prosperity: The village grows to level %s, and you are its hero
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.intro.2: Oh, sorry! Didn't see you there. I'm %4$s. Wondering why I was complaining? Let me tell you...
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.intro.3: Short story: I was kicked out of my village over a stupid drone incident. They don't get how my tech could help us grow.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.intro.4: Maybe you could help me reach my goal? My knowledge will be very useful to you!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.proposal: What do you say, %1$s? Want to build a high-tech settlement together?
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.accept.1: Awesome! I knew you had vision. This Supply Terminal here is our key to expansion.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.accept.2: Complete contract orders for prosperity points and build my blueprints to level up!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.decline: Ah, a shame... I'll be right here with my terminal if you change your mind.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.doubt: Hey, it was just a tiny glitch! Mostly harmless... Think about it, alright?
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.return: Back to business, %1$s? Ready to build that tech village with me?
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.1: Level %2$s already! Here are your blueprints: Drone Workshop I and Residence I. Let's get to work!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.2: Village Level %2$s reached! Take Power Station I and Hydroponic Farm I. Energy and food are key!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.3: Level %2$s! Unlocked Outpost II for storage and Swarm Dock, plus Market Hall I. We're growing!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.4: Level %2$s complete! You earned Residence II and Watch Tower I. Time to boost population and defense.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.5: Halfway there—Level %2$s! Here's Drone Workshop II and Hydroponic Farm II for biogas production!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.6: Level %2$s! Here come Power Station II with gas turbines and Market Hall II. Feel the power grid expand!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.7: Level %2$s! Unlocked Outpost III Command Center and Watch Tower II. We look like a real base now!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.8: Level %2$s! Take Residence III and Hydroponic Farm III for livestock ranching. Luxury living!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.9: Level %2$s! Unlocked Power Station III steam engines and Market Hall III taxi network. Almost at the peak!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.10: Level %2$s! The ultimate tech unlocked: Drone Workshop III Mech Bay and Watch Tower III. We did it!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.need_prospe: We need more prosperity points, %1$s! Complete a few more contracts at the terminal first.
Our reputation isn't high enough yet. Finish more contract orders so we can hit Level %2$s.
Keep those contracts moving! We need more contract prosperity before expanding further.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.need_buildi: Hold on, %1$s! We still need to build %3$s before upgrading the village.
Almost ready! Just finish constructing %3$s and we can advance to Level %2$s.
Don't forget %3$s! Get that up and running, then come back to see me.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.unlearned.1: Hey, check your bag! Right-click that blueprint disc in your hand to learn it first.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.unlearned.2: You have the blueprint disc, but haven't learned it! Hold it and right-click to learn it!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.unlearned.3: Hold the disc and right-click to study it! I can't grade what you haven't read yet.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.built.1: Nice work on %3$s, %1$s! That's going to give our settlement a massive boost.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.built.2: Awesome! %3$s is fully operational. Our vision is really coming together!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.built.3: %3$s is up! Great placement, %1$s. What should we work on next?
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.built.power: Hah! Did you feel that spark? Power grid online! Now the real tech begins.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.built.drone: Finally, my precious babies have a home! Watch those drones automate our hard work.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.built.marke: Trade routes are open! The local economy is officially up and running.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.1: Need anything else, %1$s? If not, I've got some circuits to tweak.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.2: Catch you later! Don't work too hard... actually, do. We have a village to build!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.3: Keep up the great work out there, partner. Let me know when you need new blueprints.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.4: Stay safe out there! Come back whenever you're ready for the next upgrade.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.mornin: Morning, %1$s! Best time of day to crank up the generators and get building.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.night: Burning the midnight oil? Be careful in the dark, tech looks creepy at night.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.raid: Hey! Why are you talking to me?! Get out there and defend the village!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.idle.market: Market Day is in full swing! Great time to cash in those contracts for prosperity!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.finale.1: Look at this place, %1$s... From a lonely guy in a cabin to the most advanced base in the region!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.finale.2: They said my drones were useless back home. Look at us now! We built a thriving futuristic settlement.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.finale.3: I couldn't have done any of this without you, partner. Thank you for believing in my tech.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.after.1: Hey boss! Just keeping an eye on our masterpiece. Everything is running at 100%!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.after.2: Best co-founder ever! Feel free to relax, %1$s, our settlement is legendary now.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.after.3: Ah, %1$s! Ready to enjoy the view of the finest automated village around?
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.no_terminal: Hey! Where's my Supply Terminal?! I can't process any contracts without it!
Uh oh... The terminal is missing or damaged! Place it back down so I can get back to work!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.guest.1: Welcome to the Outpost, guest! The base level is shared, but I have personal blueprint discs for you.
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.guest.2: Hey there! Working with %5$s? Grab your own set of discs from me whenever you level up!
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.prosperity.ready: %s prosperity points: enough for the next level. Build the last level's blueprints, then talk to the Mechanist
gui.cyberfarm.terminal.village.none.hint: Talk to the Drone Mechanist: he has a plan for a tech village. Filled contracts already count towards its prosperity
schematic.cyberfarm.village.outpost_2.de: A loading bay by the cabin: a Drone Dock for a Transport drone to fill the terminal, chests, and a Builder Swarm Dock on its pad.
schematic.cyberfarm.village.outpost_3.de: A post behind the cabin: a Hologram Table mapping the village, an antenna, and the bell the villagers gather at.
schematic.cyberfarm.village.drone_worksh: A hangar with a Drone Assembler and a Drone Dock, wired to the town grid, a pad out front.
A wing with three Drone Docks, crates, and a second pad.
Drone Workshop III: Mech Repair Hall
A hall tall enough for the mech, a gantry crane, solar arrays and fuel tanks.
schematic.cyberfarm.village.power_statio: Two Combustion Generators fed by hoppers, one energy line out to the transformer.
Two Gas Turbines piped to two Gas Tanks: fill them with methane or biogas.
A full Steam Engine with its own Gas Tank, and a cooling tower.
schematic.cyberfarm.village.hydroponic_f: Watered crop beds under glass, a Drone Dock for a Harvester or a Planter.
Chest, hopper, Bio-Digester and Gas Tank: the harvest becomes biogas for the Power Station.
Two pens under a half barn, hay, a trough and a Drone Dock for a Rancher or a Breeder.
Three beds for new villagers, a kitchen with a smoker.
Two more beds, a lectern and a cartography table for a librarian and a cartographer.
Two more beds, a brewing stand, a cauldron and a stonecutter, a roof garden.
schematic.cyberfarm.village.market_hall_: Stalls built on job sites round the village bell.
Racks of barrels and a Drone Dock for a Transport drone.
A pad with a Drone Dock for a Taxi drone, a shelter and a windsock.
schematic.cyberfarm.village.watch_tower_: A stone tower with a lookout and the alarm bell.
A wall with a gate and floodlit corners round the tower.
A guard deck over the gate with two Drone Docks, lookouts on the corners.
tooltip.cyberfarm.blueprint_disc: Right-click to learn it: the building shows in your Multiblock Projector

gui.cyberfarm.terminal.range.hint: Show the village's bounds in the world, %s blocks from the terminal each way: its buildings go inside. Click again to hide them
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.level.build: Right-click each disc to learn it, then project it inside the village and build it. Come back when they both stand!
dialogue.cyberfarm.mechanist.discs: Here, your own copies of the blueprints. Right-click them to learn them, partner!
